biotools.summary: Provides a suite of R functions to analyze gene expression experiments on the OpenArray real-time PCR platform. OAtools fits logistic regressions to fluorescence curves to distinguish between real amplification and false positives. OAtools supports data import, analysis, and visualization through plots and a dynamic HTML report.
